## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run lint` and `npm run meteogram:check` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behaviour change (or a note below on why not)
- [ ] UI change: checked in a browser (which one, the steps, before/after screenshots below)
- [ ] The vendored meteogram isn't edited by hand (change it upstream, release, then `npm run meteogram:sync`)
- [ ] README or docs updated if behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`fix:`, `feat:`, `chore:` …)
